Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different historical figures named “Anna of Hungary.” Instead of distinguishing Anna of Hungary (Byzantine empress), wife of Andronikos II and daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman, from Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macsó (daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina), the Planner prematurely assumed Anna’s mother was Maria Laskarina. This misinterpretation ignored search results indicating Elizabeth the Cuman as the correct mother and led the workflow toward confirming the wrong lineage, resulting in the incorrect maternal grandmother.
